title: Pantulan Diam di Ruang Tertutup
theme: Menjelajahi ketidakpastian yang pelan-pelan menyelinap ke dalam rutinitas, memaksa karakter untuk beradaptasi dengan perubahan tak terduga yang mungkin hanya ilusi.

cover.prompt: Empty apartment lift interior at early morning. A gently worn silver mirror dominates one wall, reflecting soft, diffused light. A subtle, almost imperceptible visual nuance on the mirror's surface suggests a departure from accustomed predictability. Cinematic composition, golden hour illumination.
cover.style: Cinematic photography, shallow depth of field, warm color grading

meta.plan_summary: Elara, a young professional, encounters increasingly unsettling anomalies in her apartment lift's mirror reflections, leading to paranoia and doubts about her sanity. The climax reveals a distinct, static figure in the mirror when the lift is empty. She eventually finds a simple, logical explanation rooted in minor mirror deformation and security camera reflections, which brings a melancholic relief and profound reflection on the mind's ability to create illusion from trivial details.
meta.target_emotion: Kecemasan, introspeksi, kelegaan melankolis, refleksi diri
